column1: # HIPAA eligible services — the source of truth for hipaa-eligibility.
# Read docs/hipaa-eligibility.md before editing. Short version:
#   - Rows with on_aws_list=yes mirror the AWS HIPAA Eligible Services
#     Reference VERBATIM in the service column. The weekly upstream check diffs
#     on that column, so do not paraphrase it.
#   - status: eligible | carve-out | pending | not-allowlisted | platform-only
#       eligible         on the AWS list; prefixes allowlisted
#       carve-out        NOT on the list, holds no PHI; prefixes allowlisted
#       pending          plausibly a feature of a listed service, unconfirmed;
#                        treated as not-allowlisted until decided (fails closed)
#       not-allowlisted  denied in uat/prod, flagged in dev/test
#       platform-only    allowlisted for named platform principals only
#   - iam_prefixes, config_namespaces: comma-separated. A config entry may be a
#     namespace (AWS::EC2) or a full type (AWS::ECR::PublicRepository); the most
#   - reviewed_by: opaque id of the human who checked the row against the page.
#     "pending" until someone has. Never a name (CLAUDE.md, personal data).
# Nothing regenerates this file from a scrape. Edit it by hand, in a PR.
